Let \(x=EF\). From the Law of Cosines and the area relation,
\[
\cos\theta=\frac{4825-x^2}{4200},\qquad \sin\theta=\frac{x}{100}.
\]
Using \(\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1\):
\[
\left(\frac{4825-x^2}{4200}\right)^2+\left(\frac{x}{100}\right)^2=1.
\]
This simplifies to
\[
x^4-7886x^2+5640625=0,
\]
so
\[
x^2=3943\pm 504\sqrt{39}.
\]
Thus the possible \(x\)-values are
\[
x=9\sqrt{39}+28 \quad \text{and} \quad x=9\sqrt{39}-28.
\]
The area is \(\frac{21x}{2}\), so the difference between maximum and minimum areas is
\[
\frac{21}{2}\left((9\sqrt{39}+28)-(9\sqrt{39}-28)\right)
=\frac{21}{2}\cdot 56=588.
\]

\[
\boxed{588}
\]
